profile.name: Thayagapriyan Dravidamani
profile.lede: Ten years making enterprise systems agree on a contract — Salesforce to SAP S4/HANA, Hybris to AS400, Kafka at 10MB a message. I design the API-led layer underneath, then automate the pipeline that ships it. Lately the same discipline applied to agent runtimes on AWS Bedrock.

experience.title: Systems Integration Lead
experience.detail: Integration architecture for Salesforce, SAP S4/HANA and e-commerce programs. Delivered the SAP migration layer on a canonical data model, architected 10MB+ Kafka streaming inside Mule, and set the platform's security patterns — AWS Signature V4 and Salesforce JWT with RSA key pairs.

experience.title: Senior MuleSoft Developer
experience.detail: Warranty, insurance and financial services integrations. Contract-first SOAP aggregation across Salesforce and Big Machines, a dynamic multi-PDF generation service with audit logging, and JPMC payment authorization lifecycle integration.
